data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mala'ika' which means 'angels'. In Islamic tradition, the name Malaeka is given to a girl, symbolizing her pure and divine nature, reminiscent of the heavenly beings that serve and protect. The name Malaeka carries the meaning “Angelic One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Malaeka usually hope their child will grow to embody angelic one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
